title: Percentage of Orders With Multiple Products
description:
Calculate the **percentage of orders that contain more than one distinct product**. Return total orders, multi-product orders, and the rate as a percentage.

**Table: order_items** — `item_id`, `order_id`, `product_id`

Output columns: `total_orders`, `multi_product_orders`, `multi_product_rate_pct`.
solution_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN product_count > 1 THEN order_id END) AS multi_product_orders, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN product_count > 1 THEN order_id END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) * 100, 2) AS multi_product_rate_pct FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t;

test_cases.description: 7 total orders; orders 101,103,105,107 have multiple products (4 multi-product orders); rate = 4/7*100 = 57.14%

hints: First subquery: GROUP BY order_id and compute COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) per order.
Outer query: count total distinct order_ids and use a CASE WHEN to count only those with product_count > 1.
Divide multi_product_orders / total_orders * 100 for the percentage; cast to NUMERIC before dividing.
explanation: Order 101: 3 products ✓. Order 102: 1 product ✗. Order 103: 2 products ✓. Order 104: 1 product ✗. Order 105: 3 products ✓. Order 106: 1 product ✗. Order 107: 2 products ✓. Multi-product orders: 4. Rate: 4/7 * 100 = 57.14%.
